title: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
description: The former UK PM said: "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning".

title: Watch: Why Russian strike on train could be sign of escalation
description: No casualties were reported after a Russian drone struck a train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials left the area.

title: MPs and Lords call for new law to address AI threat to human rights
description: Existing laws are not equipped to address the risks to human rights being posed by artificial intelligence, UK politicians say.

title: Deep-fried food banned under new school dinner rules in England
description: The government describes its new school food standards as "once-in-a-generation changes".

title: I had 11 years of chemotherapy for a cancer I didn't have
description: Becky Jones is among more than 40 people taking legal action against a hospital trust.

title: The Pitt is up for 25 Emmys - but the show's biggest fans are real-life doctors
description: Those in the medical profession say the HBO Max show about a US hospital emergency room is the most realistic medical drama yet.

title: Refereeing body admits judgement error over Haaland winner in Manchester derby
description: The Premier League refereeing body Pro Ref admits an error of judgement in awarding Erling Haaland's winner in the Manchester derby.

title: Buckingham Palace works uncover trove of everyday items dating back to 1800s
description: A collection of historic, forgotten items have been found during the restoration of the London royal residence.

title: Why a fresh wave of North Korean soldiers may fight in Russia's war in Ukraine
description: North Korea will continue to send its soldiers to fight in Russia's war, but only for as long as it is profitable to do so, writes the BBC's Quentin Sommerville.
